title: The melt, then the re-write

members.role: the figure is WRITTEN at its datum by the hand (E50) - the number as it is quoted
the page-species carrier for the verb
the figure's own ink MELTS where it stands (E88's melt - the ink, never the board) and the hand RE-WRITES the new number at the SAME datum

does: A written figure melts off its own datum and the hand re-writes what it means in the same place: the number leaves as ink and comes back as something else, with the board never moving.
